[[File:Theedroyalpalace.png|thumb|200px|[[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], residence of the Monarch of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]]]

The '''Monarch of Naboo''' was the [[King/Legends|king]] or [[Queen/Legends|queen]] ruling over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. This monarch served as an elected official since a political restructuring circa [[150 BBY/Legends|150 BBY]] and held the powers of [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], Head of Government and [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]].

==History==
From the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] point of view, the monarchy of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo people]] was their single most important institution, and its origins could be traced back to the earliest days of their society.<ref name="SON">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> Around [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] explorer [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan]], discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] with a fleet of three [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Groups of [[Human/Legends|Human]] refugees fleeing a civil war on [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]], led by none other than Kwilaan, settled in the mountains and great grass plains of Naboo.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The settlers established various city-states, which were in a constant struggle with each other. Additionnally, the colonists clashed with the amphibious [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], who were native to the planet. In that time of conflict, the Grizmalltian&mdash;who had become the Naboo&mdash;eventually appointed [[First Queen of Naboo|one woman]] their leader. She accepted the position and title of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], but refused to start a hereditary dynasty, decreeing that her people would elect the wisest among them after her [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="SON" />

Despite the early establishment of a meritocratic democracy,<ref name="SON" /> the Naboo did shift to a dynastic system. [[King/Legends|King]] [[Narmlé]] was the earliest known monarch of the line that would eventually be known as the line of kings, a hereditary monarchy solidified in history by King [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]].

Upon ending the [[Time of Suffering/Legends|Time of Suffering]], Jafan established a unified kingdom at [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and the [[Great Time of Peace/Legends|Great Time of Peace]] ensued.
